Three changes I made to Cache Keeper, fyi only:

1. The handoff button now first runs a skill of mine that saves what's worth keeping to my memory and project notes. Then it writes the handoff note and offers to clear the chat.

2. I replaced the cold-send guard's "Compact first" option with "Hand off to a fresh chat," since compacting skips that save. The new option holds the message you typed and sends it to the fresh chat with the handoff note.

3. Chats already open when the mod loaded showed no line above the prompt until Claude's next reply, and the guard missed the first message in the big idle chats it's meant for. Mine reads the time of the last reply from the chat's history file at startup.
